meta.name: financial-modeling
meta.description: Builds and stress-tests financial models for forecasting, scenario planning, and decision support — revenue build, cost structure, driver logic, and the sensitivities that show where a plan breaks. Use this to model a decision's financial consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model before relying on it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建并压力测试财务模型，预判业务决策的财务后果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要对投资、招聘或长期计划做财务影响分析，或想验证他人模型的可靠性。
copy.tagline_en: Build and stress-test financial models to predict outcomes and pressure-test plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess the financial impact of a decision, investment, or hire before committing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按“输入—计算—输出”三层结构搭建财务模型，用驱动因素构建收入，区分固定/变动/阶梯固定成本，并给出敏感性分析，指出最关键的假设和盈亏平衡点。
howto.when: 当你要评估某个决策的财务后果、构建预测或长期计划、评估投资或招聘，或想压力测试他人模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个投资方案做成财务模型，找出最敏感的假设。
say.note: Claude 将构建模型并做敏感性分析。

say.text: 按驱动因素建一个三年营收预测，分固定和变动成本。
say.note: 它会用驱动因素法建模并拆解成本结构。

say.text: 帮我压力测试这份商业计划书里的模型，写清风险。
say.note: 它会检验模型在不利情景下的表现。

howto.what_en: Claude builds financial models with three separated layers (inputs, calculations, outputs), driver-based revenue, cost structure breakdown, and sensitivity analysis showing key assumptions and breakeven points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to model a decision's financial consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model.

say_en.text: Build a financial model for this investment plan and identify the most sensitive assumptions.
say_en.note: Claude will build the model and run sensitivity analysis.

say_en.text: Create a three-year revenue forecast driven by volume and price, with fixed and variable costs.
say_en.note: It will use driver-based modeling and cost structure.

say_en.text: Stress-test the model in this business plan and outline the risks.
say_en.note: It will test how the model performs in downside scenarios.
